<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Description">Description</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Basalt_Deltas?section=1&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Description" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Basalt_Deltas?action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section's source code: Description"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>The basalt deltas is the second rarest Nether biome, making up around 16% of the Nether by volume, and can generate next to any other Nether biome except for the <a href="/w/Crimson_forest" class="mw-redirect" title="Crimson forest">crimson forest</a>.
</p><p>The rough and jagged terrain of basalt deltas is composed largely of <a href="/w/Basalt" title="Basalt">basalt</a> and <a href="/w/Blackstone" title="Blackstone">blackstone</a> and features numerous <a href="/w/Delta" title="Delta">deltas</a>, shallow pools of <a href="/w/Lava" title="Lava">lava</a>, and <a href="/w/Magma_Block" title="Magma Block">magma blocks</a>, typically reaching depths of 1 to 3 blocks. The biome's fog is a dull lilac color, and ambient ash particles float through the air. Archipelagos with islands of different sizes can be found around the <a href="/w/Lava_sea" class="mw-redirect" title="Lava sea">lava seas</a> nearby. On the ceiling, <a href="/w/Glowstone_blob" class="mw-redirect" title="Glowstone blob">glowstone blobs</a> generate as usual. Both <a href="/w/Brown_mushrooms" class="mw-redirect" title="Brown mushrooms">brown</a> and <a href="/w/Red_mushroom" class="mw-redirect" title="Red mushroom">red mushrooms</a> still grow in this biome on top of the basalt blocks.
</p><p><a href="/w/Nether_fortress" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether fortress">Nether fortresses</a> and <a href="/w/Ruined_Portal" title="Ruined Portal">ruined portals</a> can be found here. <a href="/w/Nether_quartz_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether quartz ore">Nether quartz ore</a>, <a href="/w/Nether_gold_ore" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether gold ore">Nether gold ore</a>, and the rare <a href="/w/Ancient_debris" class="mw-redirect" title="Ancient debris">ancient debris</a> generate underground, but are more difficult to obtain due to the abundance of deltas and lava seas. Ore also spawns more frequently to compensate for the significantly reduced amount of <a href="/w/Netherrack" title="Netherrack">netherrack</a> in the biome. <a href="/w/Bastion_remnant" class="mw-redirect" title="Bastion remnant">Bastion remnants</a> are not present, making basalt deltas the only Nether biome to not feature them.
</p><p><a href="/w/Magma_cube" class="mw-redirect" title="Magma cube">Magma cubes</a> have a higher spawn rate in this biome than in any other biome. Occasionally, a <a href="/w/Ghast" title="Ghast">ghast</a> can be spotted. Like in all Nether biomes, <a href="/w/Strider" title="Strider">striders</a> wander the lava lakes, and sometimes spawn trapped in the countless deltas.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Trivia">Trivia</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Basalt_Deltas?section=15&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Trivia" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Basalt_Deltas?action=edit&section=15" title="Edit section's source code: Trivia"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<ul><li>Basalt deltas have no unique <a href="/w/Mood" class="mw-redirect" title="Mood">mood</a>-based <a href="/w/Ambience" title="Ambience">ambient sounds</a> in dark areas and instead borrow those of the <a href="/w/Nether_wastes" class="mw-redirect" title="Nether wastes">Nether wastes</a>.</li>
<li>According to <a href="/w/Felix_Jones" class="mw-redirect" title="Felix Jones">Felix Jones</a>, the basalt deltas biome has a subtle <a href="/w/Easter_egg" class="mw-redirect" title="Easter egg">Easter egg</a> that has not yet been found by anyone.<sup id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup></li>
<li>Much of the ambience in the basalt deltas resembles the clicking of a <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geiger_counter" class="extiw" title="w:Geiger counter">Geiger counter</a>, used to measure radioactivity.
<ul><li>During the ambience creation process, <a href="/w/Brandon_Pearce" class="mw-redirect" title="Brandon Pearce">Brandon Pearce</a> provided the keyword "radiation" to audio director <a href="/w/Samuel_%C3%85berg" title="Samuel Åberg">Samuel Åberg</a>,<sup id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-5"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup> which may explain its purpose.</li></ul></li>
<li>In <i>Bedrock Edition</i>, the basalt delta is the only nether biome that doesn't have a red water tint.</li></ul>
